reasons.COORD_MAP_MISMATCH: Does not match the map data (the map updates daily; new or renamed villages also show this)
reasons.OVERLAP_MISMATCH: Two overlapping screenshots read different values
reasons.COUNTDOWN_ARRIVAL_MISMATCH: Countdown and arrival time do not agree
reasons.DUPLICATE_VALUE: Same value appears twice, may be a duplicate read
reasons.LAYOUT_AMBIGUOUS: Cannot tell which column this value belongs to
reasons.TEXT_TOO_SMALL: Text too small; zoom in and take the screenshot again
reasons.CROP_RECHECK_MISMATCH: Zoomed re-read gave a different result
reasons.NO_CROSS_CHECK: No other field to cross-check (strict mode)
reasons.TRUNCATED_AT_EDGE: Cut off by the screenshot edge; take another one
reasons.PARSE_ERROR: Could not read this field; please fill it in
